title: Draped Green Ceremony
desc: A garden ceremony under a leafy tree canopy with white sheer swags, pink-and-white blooms climbing the greens.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The pink-white mix climbing the tree and filling the base.

items.role: Pink hydrangea heads clustered on the right tree and around the base.
White hydrangea massing along the lower arrangements.
Pink ranunculus layered into the tree-edge planting.
White roses through the base beds and aisle corners.
Pink larkspur spikes climbing with the tree greens.
White larkspur spikes rising on the left side.
Pink clematis vines scrambling up the tree trunks (form-match climbing clematis).

groups.label: Fillers
groups.blurb: Small faces scattered through the ground planting.

items.role: Small purple daisies adding violet accents (form-match small purple chrysanth types).
Yellow mini daisies as the small yellow filler blooms.
White mini daisies scattered across the beds.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: The lush tree canopy greens and trailing grasses.

items.role: Fountain grass plumes softening the planting edges.
Fine trailing grass tails hanging over the base arrangements.
Dark green pine spray giving needle texture.
Eucalyptus sprigs through the mid layer.
